Hero_Desc_Ran: A wolf warrior aimlessly wandering Elias. With a furtive smile never letting others read her, she occasionally visits the Order. She seems to be lost in thought sometimes, missing someone from her past.
Album_Ran1: Ran is a wanderer who mysteriously appeared in Elias one day. Since she lived hiding herself from the world, she seems not to understand the ways of the world and often asks me about things.
Album_Ran2: Although she is a wolf werebeast, she does not seem to get along well with other werebeasts. Diana particularly keeps an eye on her, but apparently, Ran herself does not care much. She does not make any effort to get along well with the other werebeasts and seems to think that staying near the Order is enough for her.
Album_Ran3: Ran carries around a massive Katana and might seem like a brute but she is actually a highly intelligent werebeast. Since she is renowned for her eloquence, to the point where even the sharp-witted sprite priestesses like Joanne and Ner often find themselves outmaneuvered in conversation. I let her be, because she hasn't caused any major trouble yet... But who knows? She might someday.
Album_Ran4: Ran said she had lived for a very long time and claimed that she could share much about Elias's past not recorded properly. I haven't had a deep conversation with her yet, unsure of what to ask first. But Sherum seems to have quite some interest in her stories and wants to start a new record.
Album_Ran5: Ran is bound to the past she remembers. Her own mistakes, the mistakes of others... She frequently suffers from her memories, recalling those with nostalgia and resentment. During such moments, she visits me, asking me to pet her. When I do, she seems to regain her inner peace.
Album_Ran6: Apparently, Ran's most painful memory is that of her lost friend. After her friend who's dearly special to Ran turned out to be Uros, I wasn't sure what to do... But the present always matters most, so for now I try to comfort her not to become entirely consumed by sorrow.
Album_Ran7: As I got close to Ran, spending more time with her, she eventually told me that she wished to serve me and call my "My Lord". Since I know she once referred to Urosas the same and also called her a friend, I fully understand the weight of her words. It was somewhat overwhelming but... I said if that is what she wished, she could do so.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Hate1: Probably it was too sweet for Ran. She couldn't hide her reaction—a face of disgust. She said she will never trust the sprite's food from now on.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Hate2: She was wary, wondering what to make of me serving food that's hollow inside. To ease Ran's suspicion, I had to spend 30 minutes defending my innocence!
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like1: Ran was satisfied with it, praising the fragrance and flavor. After her third cup, I had to carefully decline any further refills.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like2: Ran smiled in satisfaction, telling me that she found herself drawn to sharp and tangy flavors as she got older. In that moment she truly looked like an adult werebeast again.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like3: Ran seriously asked me what was good about getting older. After tasting a bite of rice cake soup, she silently enjoyed it without further questions.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like4: Ran told that she recalled the days of training against wooden logs. Judging by her content face, it must not have been a bad memory.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like5: Since Ran didn't want the powder to scatter everywhere, she mixed it with water and drank it. Saying the tartness raised her appetite, she ordered more.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like6: Ran praised Songpyeons with the vibrant colors. Saying the purple one particularly came to her favor, she smiled.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like7: Though Ran initially agreed just to taste a bite, thinking about my effort, she was surprised. Because the next thing she saw was the empty box of chocolates in front of her.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like8: Saying not to want to sneeze due to the powder, Ran mixed it with water and drank it. After drinking it, she marveled that only a drink could be filling.
Food_ChefNote_Ran_Like9: Ran said the dazzling, colorful candies reminded her of the gems collected by dragons. Picking out a purple one, she smiled in satisfaction.

LoveLetter_Ran:
Master, I hope you have been well.

Like wildflowers scattered by the wind, I wandered from place to place. Yet a considerable time has already passed since I met you and settled at the Order. The moon was especially bright last night. Your touch suddenly came to mind, so I wrote these few words to convey the feelings I have held until now. If you have time today, please come and see me. I will be waiting.

Ran
LoveCall_Ran:
Greetings, Master.
Today, while wandering from place to place for the first time in a while, you suddenly came to mind, so I contacted you.
This never happened before I met you. It seems that I, too, am gradually changing.
Or perhaps a breeze from the Order carried your scent to me.

Have you been living comfortably, Master?
Now and then, I think it might be pleasant to walk wherever your feet lead without choosing a destination.
At times, you may encounter a cool breeze, or perhaps a face you have missed.
Ah, I do not mean that you should wander without direction as I did in my memories of the past.

This call has grown rather long.
Somehow, I remembered the touch of your hand stroking my head and found myself reluctant to end it.
Then I shall take my leave here.
Until we meet again, Master.
